# IRwaOracleEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/interfaces/IRwaOracleEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IRwaOracleEvents

Interface defining events emitted by the Real World Asset (RWA) Oracle contract.


## Events
### PriceUpdated
Emitted when the price is successfully updated.


```solidity
event PriceUpdated(int256 price, uint256 timestamp, uint256 roundId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`price`|`int256`|The new price value.|
|`timestamp`|`uint256`|The timestamp of the price update.|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The ID of the round associated with this update.|

### SignerAdded
Emitted when a new authorized signer is added.


```solidity
event SignerAdded(address indexed signer);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`signer`|`address`|The address of the added signer.|

### SignerRemoved
Emitted when an authorized signer is removed.


```solidity
event SignerRemoved(address indexed signer);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`signer`|`address`|The address of the removed signer.|

### ThresholdUpdated
Emitted when the signature verification threshold is updated.


```solidity
event ThresholdUpdated(uint256 threshold);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`threshold`|`uint256`|The new signature threshold.|
